notes.title: CONTENT UPDATE 2025
notes.content:
Hello dear players!
It's been almost 6 years since I have released SINNERS.
I was thinking about making a sequel to the game, which I ultimately cancelled. But that gave me the opportunity to implement some those ideas into an update. So I decided to do a content update for SINNERS!

tl;dr:
[list]
[*] NEW CONTENT
[*] NEW GAME+
[*] SOME CHANGES
[*] BUG FIXES
[/list]

Changelog:
[list]
[*] Added New Game+ (available after seeing the credits)
[*] Added new content (new puzzles and more [available in new game+])
[*] Added a dozen names to the memorial plaque (there was a challenge on my community Discord!)
[*] Improved the puzzle in room 5 by making it availble to read the instructions step-by-step
[*] Made some graphicals changes (room 5 and 6) 
[*] Improved some sounds
[*] Halving the size of the game by converting audio files
[*] Fixed a softlock bug that could occur when solving room 4 and leaving the room without taking the key
[/list]


Have fun playing!!

notes.title: Steam Wintersale - SINNERS 25% off & Demo release!
notes.content:
Dear [strike]Sinners[/strike] Saints out there.

As the year 2019 proceeds to its end, Steam has another sale going on.
This is the chance to grab SINNERS with a discount of 25%!

But if you're not sure to buy this game, you can check out the brand new demo that has been released today! So try before you buy! Wish you a lot of fun with this game!
Thank you for this incredible year. My childhood dream of releasing a game on Steam has finally become true. :)

I wish you a happy christmas time and a good start for the new year!

Greetings

Mr.Prinz

notes.title: YOUR dialogues
notes.content:
Hello wonderful people out there!
Before SINNERS has been released I had a small crowdfunding campaign running. In this campaign you had the opportunity to let me record a voice line with the "SINNERS voice" for you.

So I made a small compilation of every dialogue you wanted me to record and the results are kinda funny. :)

Most dialogues are in German, but there are some in English as well.

Have fun!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6yhYMHQ75pw

Regards,
Mr.Prinz
